name: What is the biggest mistake people make in a gut renovation?

mainEntity.name: What common planning mistake causes gut renovation budgets to explode in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What common planning mistake causes gut renovation budgets to explode in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common mistake is assuming a gut renovation is just a bigger version of a cosmetic remodel. In reality, once you remove walls and finishes, the project often becomes a system-by-system rebuild. Homeowners underestimate design fees, permit costs, engineering, temporary housing, utility upgrades, and the contingency needed for hidden problems. They may also select finishes before the layout and rough infrastructure are fully resolved, which creates rework. Another frequent issue is comparing contractor bids that do not include the same scope, making the cheapest quote look more attractive than it really is. A better approach is to define the project in writing, confirm what is included and excluded, and reserve enough budget for discoveries after demolition. That discipline protects both the budget and the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistake is underestimating hidden work and treating a gut renovation like a simple finish upgrade. Homeowners often budget only for visible changes and forget permits, temporary living, design fees, system upgrades, and contingency. That leads to change orders and stalled construction.
